material.name: Ilford HP5 Plus · Ilfotec HC 6½ min

publication: ILFORD HP5 Plus Technical Information, November 2018

conditions.agitation: intermittent; four inversions in first10seconds and first10seconds of each further minute
conditions.format: representative of roll and sheet film formats
conditions.exposure_axis: relative log exposure; no absolute ISO/exposure calibration inferred
conditions.density: total density as plotted; no separate base/fog added
conditions.shoulder: Published curve leaves the plotted exposure range without a measured shoulder; constant numerical endpoint extension only.

characteristic.reconstruction_grid: 257 uniform relative-log-exposure knots sampled from the monotone ink trace; raw constraints retain image-axis coordinates

sensitivity.calibration: piecewise linear through printed ticks and zero baseline; FP4 tick spacing is uneven

source_raster.curation: threshold128, trace thick connected ink after excluding grid; monotone density reconstruction within ink/reading allowance

reconstruction.method: Least-squares clamped uniform cubic B-spline fitted to the retained samples with nondecreasing controls and fixed endpoints; limited complexity within the recorded density-reading allowance. Samples retain the graph trace, not interpolation knots.

sensitivity.definition: Relative sensitivity as plotted on the axis labelled Sensitivity; interpreted as linear, not logarithmic. Wedge spectrogram to tungsten light2850K is retained as the test condition; no additional illuminant division or photon/energy conversion is inferred. Absolute scale is removed by virtual gray normalization. No manufacturer radiometric certification is implied.
